label: copy step recall_idx 2 outputting h after h/i/j, in sequences starting h/v/k/l (weak)
explanation: Very sparse feature (95 activations on dev), weak magnitudes (mean 0.12, max 0.21). About 73% of activation mass is at the copy step where the model outputs original token 2 (recall_idx == 2, t = L+2). There it fires mostly when that output is h (62% of mass) and the input (orig(1)) is h, i or j, and more often when the sequence starts with h, v, k or l and has no digits. About 24% of mass is in the original phase at late positions (t = 3..8) or on <DEL>, mostly in sequences that start with h. Neither part is captured precisely. recall_idx==2 & out h & input h/i/j gets about 56% of mass but only 3% precision, and adding a first-token condition raises precision to 14% at 34% recall. Most matching contexts do not fire, so the feature seems to depend on a fine conjunction of sequence contents that I could not pin down. It does not fire at t = 0..2, at copy steps other than recall_idx 2 (and rarely at recall_idx 0), or in sequences with 3+ digits. I did not find any variable that reliably modulates magnitude.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: recall_idx=2 & in_tok=i (+2.91), orig0=h (+2.81), orig1=h (+2.02), prev_tok=k (+1.89), recall_idx=2 & in_tok=j (+1.87), out_tok=h (+1.78). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-2.32), prev3_tok=- (-1.59), orig8=- (-1.16), prev_tok=h (-1.01).
